text:
Jordan A: Quick question — ACME asked if we can do a temporary per-token price override for a Hosted POC. They want a lower per-token rate for months 1-3 to validate usage before committing. Need to know if deal desk will approve and what guardrails we should attach.
Alex K: rough ask? numbers?
Jordan A: They expect ~30M tokens total across 3 months. Asking to drop to $0.0006/token for those months (current hosted tier is $0.0009). Also want no min for month 1, but comfortable with a $2k min months 2–3.
Marta S: we'll need ARR/ACV impact and whether this becomes a sales credit or is applied to hosted invoice. Also need run rate post-POC — do they plan to stick to our standard tier afterwards?
Jordan A: They said likely yes, at higher volume; team expects to go to dedicated after proof. But timeline is fuzzy.
Chris L: engineering note — lowering per-token is fine from infra perspective but this increases risk of unbounded test usage. Recommend caps in policy: soft limit alerts at 10M/mo and hard cap at 15M/mo during the POC unless AE escalates.
Alex K: from finance ops, we can do a one-time invoice adjustment or temporary rate override in billing system. Deal desk will need the override duration, rate, min guarantees, and an internal mitigation plan (caps + monitoring).
Jordan A: proposed package: per-token $0.0006 for months 1–3, hard cap 15M tokens/month, min charge $0 for month 1, $2k for months 2–3. Approval requested by EOD tomorrow so procurement can sign the SOW.
Sasha (deal-desk-bot): Please provide: expected total discount $ amount, reason for exception, list of guardrails, and AE vouch. Use template: ```{
  "customer":"ACME Corp",
  "override_rate":"0.0006",
  "duration_months":"3",
  "monthly_hard_cap_tokens":"15000000",
  "min_monthly_charge":"0/2000/2000"
}```
Jordan A: submitted above. Expected discount approx $9k over three months vs standard pricing (30M tokens * (0.0009-0.0006) = $9k).
Marta S: finance note: $9k erosion is acceptable for a strategic customer converting to dedicated later, but need PO or signed SOW that references this exception. Also require an internal 10% contingency buffer in the cap calculations.
Chris L: confirm monitoring — engineering can add an alert to #prod-usage-watch and auto-throttle if >15M tokens/mo. That meets the guardrail ask.
Deal Desk: Approved on condition of (1) SOW signed that lists the temporary rate and caps, (2) AE to add usage alert to stack and cc eng-oncall, (3) finance to log the discount code for audit. Valid for exactly months 1–3.
Jordan A: thanks — will update SOW and send to procurement. Will tag @Alex K and @Chris L once SOW draft ready. :white_check_mark:
Alex K: I'll prepare the billing override ticket and hold until SOW attached.
Marta S: I'll record the approval in the exception tracker and note expected $9k impact.
Jordan A: tagging for visibility @Deal Desk — pls add approval to CLM record once SOW uploaded.
Deal Desk: noted, will add once we see the signed SOW. :thumbsup:
